scope: COPY ONLY; all sources retained. No adoption of original failed attempts. No launch authorized by this preparation artifact.
hardlink_semantics: GNU tar --hard-dereference stores every regular path independently; restores bytes/verified metadata but not inode sharing. External aliases remain untouched. st_nlink joins full stat identity so link membership changes reject.
estimates: Original per-pool 32 GiB ceiling retained, not a new size measurement. Inventory counts every regular path logical size, including repeated hardlink payload; fails if ceiling is insufficient. No real payload scan during preparation.
